changes.from: GreyOrange now markets this as 'Ranger Uplift - L (RU-L)'; /ril/ page used the RIL-L name with identical specs. Launched March 2021 (GreyOrange press release). Max lift height 410 mm.
changes.to: Official Intralogistics (IL) page now lists this trim as 'Ranger Uplift - L (RU-L)': 1280 x 920 x 350 mm, 1,000 kg payload, 2 m/s - the same robot earlier listed as 'Ranger Intralogistics (RIL-L)' on greyorange.com/ril/. Launched March 2021 (GreyOrange press release). Max lift height 410 mm.
